debian_original_candidate.decision: Do not represent this inspected candidate as OpenPGP-verified.
debian_original_candidate.format: Plain text SHA512 checksum list, not clear-signed. Inspected latest and dated indexes advertise SHA512SUMS only; SHA512SUMS.sign HEAD was404 in initial readiness. No conclusion about all Debian image publication channels.

recommended_alternate.key_authority: Official https://ubuntu.com/docs/public-images/public-images-how-to/verify-image-checksum/ publishes this full fingerprint as Ubuntu image signing key; retrieved over inherited TLS/CA. No separate out-of-band Web-of-Trust is claimed.
recommended_alternate.qualification: Only signed expected image hash, official metadata, and HEAD length are verified. Image body digest, bootability under TCG, guest identity generation, application dependency transfer, and runtime execution remain untested. Alternate distro/image choice needs architectural confirmation before implementation.
recommended_alternate.signature_format: Detached OpenPGP binary signature (RSA4096/SHA512) over plaintext SHA256SUMS.
recommended_alternate.verification: /usr/bin/sqv --keyring ubuntu-cloud-pubkey.asc ubuntu-dated-SHA256SUMS.gpg ubuntu-dated-SHA256SUMS exited0 and returned the expected full fingerprint.

proposed_boot_only_resource_envelope.memory_qualification: /tmp is tmpfs and counts toward memory. Current ~11.14GiB already exceeds the conservative10.75GiB baseline for reserving the full two-guest/768MiB envelope under14GiB. Much file cache may reclaim, but no reclaim or two-guest capacity is promised. Probe one guest first only after fresh admission; permit a pair only with a fresh complete-envelope resource check. Never overlap heavy native/performance gates.
proposed_boot_only_resource_envelope.overlay_enforcement_proposal: Per-QEMU RLIMIT_FSIZE plus directory allocated-byte observation and controller stop. Sparse virtual capacity is not allocated capacity; directory observation is an abort guard, not a reserved quota or zero-overshoot guarantee.
proposed_boot_only_resource_envelope.relation_to_previous_cap: 768MiB boot-only proposal is below the original <=2GiB allowance; the original allowance was a ceiling, not reserved memory or disk.

scope: Metadata-only trust/dependency/resource readiness for a proposed local two-guest Linux-kernel probe; no NI2-053 or ADR47 acceptance.
